entities.summary: WASP-121b, formally named Tylos, is an exoplanet orbiting the star WASP-121. WASP-121b is the first exoplanet found with an extrasolar planetary stratosphere and the first that contains water. WASP-121b is in the constellation Puppis, and is about 858 light-years from Earth.
